items.followUp: What is the trend of atomic radius across a period from left to right?

rubric.why: States the direction of the atomic-radius trend down a group.
rubric.description: States that atomic radius increases down a group.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct trend.

rubric.why: Identifies the extra electron shell in each successive element as the reason for the increase.
rubric.description: Explains that each step down a group adds an electron shell.

modelAnswer: Atomic radius increases down a group.
This is because each successive element has an additional electron shell.

items.followUp: State the modern periodic law and name the scientist who arranged elements by atomic number.

rubric.why: States the defining relationship of the modern periodic law.
rubric.description: States that the properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers.

rubric.why: Names the scientist who arranged elements according to atomic number.

modelAnswer: Modern periodic law: The properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers.
Henry Moseley arranged the elements according to increasing atomic number.

rubric.why: Identifies the change of state involved in condensation.

rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the change of state.

rubric.why: Identifies cooling or heat loss as the condition that causes condensation.
rubric.description: States that the gas cools or loses heat.

modelAnswer: Condensation is the change of a gas or vapour into a liquid.
It occurs when the gas is cooled and loses heat.
